from pathlib import Path
p = Path('boltons/iterutils.py')
s = p.read_text()
s = s.replace('''        if maxsplit == 0:
            yield [src]
            return
''', '''        if maxsplit == 0:
            yield list(src)
            return
''')
s = s.replace('''    *maxsplit* times (no max by default). *sep* can be:
''', '''    *maxsplit* times (no max by default). When *maxsplit* is zero,
    yields a single list containing all values from *src*. *sep* can be:
''')
s = s.replace('''def research(root, query=lambda p, k, v: True, reraise=False, enter=default_enter):
''', '''def research(root, query=lambda p, k, v: True, reraise=False, enter=default_enter,
             cache=True):
''')
s = s.replace('''       reraise (bool): Whether to reraise exceptions raised by *query*
          or to simply drop the result that caused the error.
''', '''       reraise (bool): Whether to reraise exceptions raised by *query*
          or to simply drop the result that caused the error.
       cache (bool): Whether to cache traversed objects, as in :func:`remap`.
          Defaults to ``True``, traversing each unique object only once.
          If ``False``, shared objects are searched at each path, and circular
          references raise :exc:`RecursionError`.
''')
s = s.replace('''    remap(root, enter=_enter)
''', '''    remap(root, enter=_enter, cache=cache)
''')
p.write_text(s)
PY
python -m pytest -q tests/test_iterutils.py
